description: String validation helpers such as is_numeric and is_alphanumeric for RegTech demo scenarios. Keep validation results encoded as i64 booleans so contracts remain Z3 integer-theory friendly while the string representation stays opaque. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/string/validator — verified string validators'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm and std/string_utils.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses.

atoms.name: is_numeric_ascii_code
atoms.description: Return 1 when an ASCII code is in the digit range ['0', '9'], otherwise 0.

atoms.name: is_alphanumeric_ascii_code
atoms.description: Return 1 when an ASCII code is numeric or alphabetic, otherwise 0.
